question: How many ATT&CK software entries have Windows among their platforms?

claims.text: Found 687 record(s) in MITRE ATT&CK including S0061, S0266, S0139 and more.

task.text: How many ATT&CK software entries have Windows among their platforms?
task.rationale: algebra probe set (Era 2 Step 9 Phase G)

results.query: MATCH (v1:Software) WHERE (v1.`x_mitre_platforms` IS NOT NULL AND $p0 IN v1.`x_mitre_platforms`) WITH DISTINCT v1 WITH v1 ORDER BY v1.id WITH collect(v1) AS all_ RETURN size(all_) AS total, [x IN all_[0..1000] | {id: x.id, name: x.name}] AS rows
